steps.what: Read and match patient history, referral question and available eye-test results in the {OTHER} electronic clinical record
Examine the patient's eye and eye structures and obtain the actual findings needed for the presenting problem
Diagnose injuries, disorders, or diseases of the eye and eye structures including the cornea, sclera, conjunctiva, or eyelids by interpreting the actual evidence
Explain the actual assessment and limitations to the patient and answer questions
Write and check actual findings, assessment and limitations in the {OTHER} clinical record
Save the entry in the same {OTHER} clinical record

tasks.design: Configure a patient-linked context view and exact case-reference defaults in the {OTHER} electronic clinical record. The ophthalmologist examines, diagnoses, explains and writes the findings; no image interpretation, diagnosis or treatment is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical context and repeated case references can require extra navigation and entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native context views and fixed fields can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle findings and uncertainty require clinical examination and specialist interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The ophthalmologist integrates the actual eye examination with the patient's presentation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for clinical access, privacy and workflow review; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: patient-linked clinical views and fixed case fields can reduce navigation and re-entry without changing clinical diagnosis.

assumptions: Representative episode is diagnostic assessment with an actual clinical entry. Referral staff and test staff produce existing records; s1 reads and verifies the patient and context. S2 produces examination findings and s5 captures and checks all clinical meaning. Missing or conflicting facts require manual resolution, not inferred findings.

Only navigation and exact case references change. Native configuration first; existing links earn no gain. Clinical authoring checks are not an invented self-approval. Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated.

This diagnostic episode does not silently prescribe, administer, perform surgery or issue a patient letter. Actual treatment episodes need their own clinical decisions and actions; medication is separately modelled in 17169. Do not extrapolate across the unmeasured diagnosis/treatment mix or duplicate shared clinical entries.
Shares are provisional active effort, not observed clinic baselines; no new patient or staff data capture is assumed free.
research_questions: Which navigation and case-reference actions remain manual in observed diagnostic visits?

already_counted.description: Context reading, examination, diagnosis, explanation and full entry meaning checks remain.

incremental.description: Check case-reference defaults after clinical configuration changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.2, gross=4.8; upkeep 1.5 gives net 3.3. Low zero when native context and case defaults already remove the repetition, so add no duplicate tool. All clinical reasoning remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide and direct postoperative eye care

steps.what: Review the actual operation record, postoperative instructions and current patient context in the {OTHER} electronic clinical record
Provide postoperative care by examining recovery and assessing actual symptoms and complications
Direct the provision of postoperative care through actual discussion with the patient and care team, clarifying follow-up and unresolved needs
Write and check the actual postoperative assessment and care direction in the {OTHER} clinical record
Save the postoperative entry in the same {OTHER} record

tasks.design: Configure operation-linked record navigation and exact procedure references in the {OTHER} clinical record. The ophthalmologist assesses recovery, directs actual care and writes and checks the entry; no generated instruction changes treatment or schedules a follow-up automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Postoperative reviews can repeat operation-context retrieval and reference entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native episode links and fixed fields can remove some repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising postoperative complications requires examination and timely clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The ophthalmologist identifies when recovery differs from the expected course.

ambition.what: No automated postoperative decision or triage.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for clinical access and workflow/privacy review; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procedure-linked clinical records can reduce postoperative context retrieval while retaining examination and care direction.

assumptions: Representative episode is a postoperative review and actual clinical entry, with examination and oral care direction. The operative team produces the existing operation record; s1 verifies its match and reads the instructions. S4 captures and checks every actual assessment and care detail. No structured recovery narrative is assumed free.

Only exact episode/procedure identifiers default. Missing or conflicting sources require manual resolution. Native configuration first; existing procedure links earn no new gain. No generated medical wording or autonomous triage is proposed.

Actual prescription, medication administration, procedure, referral, appointment transaction or issued written instruction requires its own clinical authority and action if present. None is hidden in discussion or the ordinary record save. Other care-team labour is unchanged, not newly assigned or made free. Shared medication and assessment entries must be counted once across tasks.
Same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated without author self-approval. Shares are hypotheses, not measured recovery-review baselines.
research_questions: Which context and reference entries remain repeated during actual postoperative reviews?

already_counted.description: Context reading, actual assessment, care discussion and all meaningful record checks remain.

incremental.description: Check procedure-reference mappings after clinical record changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=93.9, gross=6.1; upkeep 1.5 gives net 4.6. Low zero when operative records and identifiers already link directly, so do not duplicate configuration. Actual care assessment and discussion remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop ophthalmologic service plans and procedures

steps.what: Read actual service requirements, current ophthalmologic procedures and local service evidence in {DOCS}
Develop plans and procedures for ophthalmologic services, deciding clinical scope, responsibilities, escalation and resource needs with service staff
Populate exact service, role and existing procedure references in the {DOCS} working plan template
Write the actual service plan and procedure wording and check every clinical meaning, responsibility and escalation route against original evidence
Save the working plan in the same {DOCS} file without issuing a clinical procedure

tasks.design: Configure exact service and procedure-reference population in {DOCS}. The ophthalmologist and staff develop the actual service decisions, and the ophthalmologist writes and checks the clinical procedure; the saved working plan is not an approved or implemented service change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Service plans can require repeated entry of fixed service and procedure references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields can reuse those references.
tasks.still_hard: Clinical suitability, capacity and workable escalation need real service knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: The ophthalmologist decides whether the plan can safely serve actual patients.

ambition.what: No unapproved new service is claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for service-source access, clinical workflow review and national consultation where applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact service-reference fields can assist plan assembly while clinical procedure design and validation remain human.

assumptions: Representative episode develops an actual service plan rather than executing an existing procedure. Source owners produce current service records and procedure editions; s1 reads and verifies them and s2 counts staff consultation, decisions and structured capture. Missing capacity or clinical facts require manual investigation, not a free clean service feed.

S3 explicitly copies only exact service, role, source-version and procedure identifiers selected by the clinician. Native configuration first; existing field reuse earns no gain. S4 retains all actual procedural wording and complete clinical meaning checks; no model invents care steps.

The task also permits implementation, but this development example must not be extrapolated to it. Actual institutional clinical approval, publication, staff training, resource purchase and implementation require their real actors, labour and separate final-version actions. None is hidden in this same-system save.

Ordinary authoring is not self-approval. Save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. Shares are provisional active work, not measured service-planning baselines; existing staff consultation is unchanged rather than newly free.
research_questions: Which plan fields are actually repeated rather than already populated natively?

already_counted.description: Evidence reading, service decisions and capture, full procedure writing and clinical checks remain.

incremental.description: Maintain service and controlled-procedure field mappings.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=85, gross=15; upkeep 3 gives net 12. Conservative case: a novel service has only 4 reusable reference points, giving 4-3=1. Service and clinical decisions and all procedure wording remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve and read the actual existing medication order and patient medication context in the {OTHER} electronic clinical record
Make the actual immediate clinical readiness decision for the exact ordered medication and patient, checking the order, contraindication information and present conditions
Administer topical or systemic medications to treat ophthalmic conditions and to manage pain under the actual order and current clinical readiness
Observe the actual patient response and assess further clinical needs
Write and check the actual administration and response entry in the {OTHER} medication record
Save the administration entry in the same {OTHER} record after actual administration and observation

tasks.design: Configure direct patient/order navigation in the {OTHER} electronic clinical record. The ophthalmologist reads the real order, makes the immediate readiness decision, administers the medication and records the actual response; software neither selects treatment nor administers it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Retrieving the matched order and medication context can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient/order links can reduce that navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Current suitability and response require direct clinical assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The ophthalmologist withholds administration when the actual patient condition makes the order unsuitable.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for clinical access, privacy and workflow review; national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: direct patient/order retrieval can reduce navigation while medication readiness, administration and response assessment remain clinical work.

assumptions: Representative episode is administration under an existing valid order, not producing a new prescription. The actual prescriber produces that order in existing clinical work; s1 reads and verifies it and the patient context. Missing or conflicting orders require manual clinical resolution. No new order production is treated as free.

S2 is the actual immediate clinical readiness decision for a physical intervention, not self-approval of authored paperwork. A1 covers only the exact patient, order and present conditions; any changed order or condition requires renewed readiness. No extra document-approval baseline is created.

S5 separately counts all actual medication and response capture and complete checks, after s3-s4. No administration is recorded before it occurs. The ordinary same-system save is negligible, minimum share 1 fully retained and ungated. It issues no prescription or external message.

Native links first; existing links earn no gain. Shares are hypothetical active effort, not medication timing guidance. A new-prescription episode requires its own actual treatment selection, order writing, clinical authority and issue actions; do not extrapolate this administration example or duplicate postoperative records.
research_questions: Which order retrieval actions remain manual without contributing to clinical checking?

already_counted.description: Order reading, immediate clinical readiness, actual administration, response assessment and full record checks remain.

incremental.description: Check patient/order context links after clinical configuration changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact existing medication order and patient under conditions checked in s2; changed order or condition voids readiness

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95, gross=5; upkeep 1 gives net 4. Low zero when the actual order already opens with its patient context, so introduce no duplicate navigation tool. All clinical decisions and physical care remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated clinical context and service-reference entry; all eye assessment, care, medication and procedure decisions remain clinical responsibilities.
reach: Clinical information specialist: learn episode linking and the distinction between record saves and clinical actions.
skills_to_grow: Test exact patient and procedure links
Measure navigation separately from clinical review
Trace service plans to actual clinical evidence
role.ambitious_version: An ophthalmologist with dependable case context and service-plan assembly who retains direct examination, care and medication authority.
